← classifier summary

Terminal-cars classifier — examples

488 labeled frames (6535 total) · threshold 0.5 · trained 2026-08-11T14:55:19.908Z

Ferry not-full verdicts

Every archived frame of every sailing is classified in capture order; the ferry counts as having left not full when the terminal reads empty in two consecutive frames before departure (a lone empty frame misreads ~25% of the time) — both frames of the confirming pair are shown. The pair must come after a cars-present frame, unless the whole window is a long quiet one (10+ observed-empty frames, cars never seen). Dark frames (sun below civil twilight) still count, but they are marked — navy band on the strip block, "dark" in the tooltip — because the model's error at night is ~2× daytime; night verdicts carry a ⚠ note. The signal is one-way: late-arriving cars in the final frames never cancel an earlier confirmed-empty pair. Flagged 235 of 441 sailings — 205 agree with a human capacity tag, 6 contradict one (human said Full), 24 have no tag. The crosswalk veto (a lineup seen past the crosswalk suppresses the flag) removes 25 of these, including 5 of the 6 contradictions — after the veto: 1 wrong of 210 flags.

The crosswalk classifier (see crosswalk page) deems the ferry at least 75% full when the lineup passes the crosswalk — note it never claims completely full. 146 of the 441 sailings with terminal frames were flagged.
